name: wheel-picker
title: Wheel Picker
description: An iOS-style time picker with three vertical drums for hour, minute and AM/PM. Rows curve away in perspective above and below a grey selection band; drag or flick a drum and it coasts then snaps to a value.
use: A settings form needs to set a time quickly on touch, with the familiar iOS drum feel.
avoid: It is tall, needs room for three columns, and precise values are slower than typing into a field.
a11y: Each drum is a labelled spinbutton with keyboard steps and a visible focus ring; the 3D band is a visual cue only. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded dark card holds three narrow columns of numbers under a pill-shaped grey band that marks the chosen hour, minute and AM/PM. Numbers shrink and fade toward the top and bottom edges.
behaves: Each column turns like a drum as you drag it, with the rows above and below curving away. A flick keeps it coasting before it settles on a row, and keyboard arrows step it by one.
customise: Columns with options and labels, controlled or default value, a change callback and the group label are props; row styling is in the source.
weight: light: Three columns with one transform each; springs run only while spinning.
